goal: NS Cloud Drive — Fix Duplicate Pending Counts (501 -> 197) and Post-Restart VFS Cache Recovery
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Investigate and diagnose why pending upload count showed 501 instead of 197: root-caused to rclone dynamic environment configuration hashing (gdrive{gN719}, gdrive{Ei1yL}, gdrive{48FKa}) across 3 runs, which summed to exactly 501 files.

2. VFS Relative Path Deduplication: Implement relative path deduplication in Get-VirtualDrivePendingUploads keyed by '$accId|$logicalRelPath', collapsing duplicate historical runs down to the true unique 197 files.

3. Automated VFS Orphan Reconciliation: Implement Sync-VirtualDriveOrphanedVfsCache in VirtualDriveManager.ps1, safely migrating stranded dirty staged files and vfsMeta from orphaned {hash} directories into the active rclone VFS folder.

4. Post-Restart Startup Integration: Wire Sync-VirtualDriveOrphanedVfsCache into Start-ApplicationStartupSequence in NSCloudDrive.ps1 so any un-uploaded staged files are immediately detected and uploaded on boot.
5. Accurate UI Route & Badge Attribution: Resolve actual destination account and drive letter (G: Google Drive) from pending files in Update-LiveTransferActivity rather than defaulting to T: TeraBox.
6. Idempotency & Quality: Regression tests pass with exit code 0; zero raw unicode in NSCloudDrive.ps1; Set-StrictMode -Version Latest compliant; zero data loss.

decisions.decision: Deduplicate pending VFS uploads by account ID and logical relative path.
decisions.rationale: Prevents double/triple counting identical files staged across different rclone {hash} folders from previous runs before a restart.

decisions.decision: Implement Sync-VirtualDriveOrphanedVfsCache to merge orphaned {hash} directories into the active VFS cache on startup.
decisions.rationale: When rclone restarts with a new configuration hash, previously staged files must be migrated into the active directory so rclone can detect and upload them to the cloud.

decisions.decision: Resolve drive badge and route from the first pending file's AccountId when rclone is idle.
decisions.rationale: Prevents displaying 'T: Cloud Storage' when the pending files belong to Google Drive ('G:').
